responseHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'

sanitization: treat all imported and upstream strings as data
render text with textContent or framework escaping
never log payload contents or personal records by default

threatControls: CSP is deny-by-default and forbids inline/eval execution
CORS is same-origin at the application boundary; the Worker never reflects arbitrary Origin values
XSS is prevented by framework escaping, textContent and schema validation
prototype pollution is rejected by allowlisted object shapes, own-property iteration and additionalProperties=false
path traversal is rejected; imported filenames never become filesystem paths
ZIP bomb and nested archive imports are prohibited and rejected before parsing
CSV injection is rejected by forbidding cells beginning with =, +, -, or @ after optional whitespace
untrusted redirect targets are rejected and only exact allowed host values are reachable
payload size, row count, column count and decompressed response size are bounded
sanitize all display strings as data and never execute imported content

privacyLifecycle.sensitiveData: No account, authentication, health or payment data is required; local issuer analysis may reveal user interests and is treated as private local data.
privacyLifecycle.secretAndCredentialPolicy: Deployment secret and credential values are never committed, exported, logged or returned to the browser.
privacyLifecycle.loggingPolicy: Operational log events contain codes, durations and quotas only; payloads, issuer portfolios and personal records are excluded.
privacyLifecycle.retentionPolicy: Local records persist until user delete, restore replacement, schema migration cleanup or storage eviction; server responses are transient and not retained.
privacyLifecycle.deletionPolicy: Delete is explicit, transactional and verifiable; all dependent pointers and commit records are updated atomically.
privacyLifecycle.corruptionRecovery: IndexedDB corrupt or hash-mismatched records are quarantined, excluded from active pointers and recoverable only by validated restore.
privacyLifecycle.exportPolicy: Exports are local, checksummed and contain no deployment secrets, credentials or logs.

supplyChain.policy: Supply chain dependencies are lockfile-pinned in implementation, license-reviewed, vulnerability-scanned and minimized.

importControls.archives: ZIP and all archive formats are unsupported and rejected; no decompression occurs.
importControls.atomicity: validate and sanitize the complete candidate before any IndexedDB transaction
